versions.content: Usage of module identifier and category In any case, this identifier in the BSWMD shall be used to document the relation of an artifact to the standard and thus is a useful information for the conformance test. In addition to this, the generic category attribute (inherited from Identifiable ) shall be used for a general classification of a BswModuleDescription as shown in the following table. This allows to check for constraints.
